read_colmap_model: read a COLMAP sparse reconstruction model from a folder in binary or text format using read_model
write_colmap_model: write cameras, images, and 3D points to a COLMAP model folder in binary or text format using write_model
convert_colmap_format: convert a COLMAP model between binary and text formats using the CLI with input and output format arguments
convert_quaternion_to_rotation_matrix: convert a quaternion vector to a 3x3 rotation matrix using qvec2rotmat
convert_rotation_matrix_to_quaternion: convert a 3x3 rotation matrix to a quaternion vector using rotmat2qvec
